name: Pure Companion Plaque Removal Powder (seaweed)
note: Dental powder: 100% natural seaweed (Ascophyllum nodosum). Label: protein 6%, fat 4%, ash 20.4%, natural iodine 670 mg/kg (= 670 µg per g – the reason to keep the dose small). Label dose: cats/small dogs up to 10 kg ½–1 scoop a day (scoop size not stated – weigh one); not for animals with iodine/seaweed sensitivity or treated for hyperthyroidism. Not declared, estimated: Ca, P, K, Mg, Fe, Zn, Cu, Mn and fibre from Feedipedia (dried rockweed, A. nodosum; as fed at 88% DM); sodium 3.6% and selenium 0.4 mg/kg from an A. nodosum seaweed meal analysis; water 12%; energy estimated (modified Atwater; real value lower as seaweed fibres are poorly digested – irrelevant at <1 g). Vitamins and oxalate not declared – counted as 0. Max 1 g/day set here because of iodine (AAFCO max 2.75 mg/1000 kcal for the whole diet). Pure Companion Ltd, London.
